sources: https://www.reservevaparks.com/Web/#!park/5 (US eDirect API prod-va-rdr.recreation-management.tylerapp.com: search/grid for facilities 30 Campground A and 31 Campground B and search/details for each unit, start date 2027-05-04, read 2026-10-21)

fees.source: reservevaparks.com search/details for 2027-05-04 (Campground A Electric/Water sites 'Rate' 37.00, Campground B Electric/Water sites 'Rate' 43.00), consistent with the entry's own fees note ('$37-43 a night for a site with electric and water'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/chippokes (Loop B: 'Sites 1 through 18 have water and electric ... accept 20, 30 and 50-amp current'; Loop A sites 19-50 electricity and water, 20/30-amp) + reservevaparks.com search/details, read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two loops. Loop B: 18 paved, level electric/water sites for rigs up to 50 ft, 20/30/50-amp, 6 of them pull-through. Loop A: 32 electric/water sites (20/30-amp), shadier, mostly not level, tents/pop-ups and some RVs to 30 ft (the booking site lists 16-30 ft), all back-in; plus a tents-only group area. Up to six people per site; specific sites are reservable.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/chippokes (Loop A, Loop B) + reservevaparks.com search/details (32 + 18 Electric/Water units; Campground B vehicle length 50, 6 Pull Through), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/chippokes ('There's a laundry facility, open March through November, near the Campground B bathhouse'; amenities 'Camp Store/Gift Shop', 'Dump Station', 'Showers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Specific campsites are reservable online or at 800-933-PARK. Check in at the office; after hours, check-in information is at the entrance contact station. Check-in 4 p.m., check-out 1 p.m. The booking site gives a 14-night maximum on each campsite.

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/chippokes ('Chippokes allows guests to reserve specific campsites') + reservevaparks.com search/details ('MaxStay': 14), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed reservable by site with a 14-night max; fees high raised 37 -> 43 (Loop B's rate on the booking site; the entry's own note already said $37-43), low $37 confirmed. Season already manual and matches ('first Friday in March through the first Monday in December'). Added 50-amp + water, 50 sites (to 50 ft in Loop B, 6 pull-throughs), showers, laundry, dump, camp store. Not stated: sewer, this park's booking window/cutoff, first-come policy.
